comment_regular: Native encoded animation-key resolver. A candidate is valid only when its map entry's selector virtual returns a sequence. Order: exact key; weapon-prefix compatibility; fast-move group to normal-move group; on the outer pass only, strip movement prefix; finally replace nonzero group with Idle (0). Returns 0 on failure.
